# Dpd2

DPD is a digital product delivery platform for selling ebooks, software, music, and other digital goods.

Category: Sales & CRM. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/dpd2/.

## Actions

- **DPD: Ping API** (read-only): Ping the api to check its status.
- **Get Storefront** (read-only): Retrieve details of a specific storefront by its id.
- **List DPD Customers** (read-only): List customers in your dpd account.
- **List DPD Purchases** (read-only): List all purchases made through your dpd account.
- **List Storefronts** (read-only): List all storefronts in your dpd account.
- **List Subscribers** (read-only): List subscribers for a given storefront.
- **Verify DPD Notification** (read-only): Verify a webhook notification's authenticity by posting back the original signature and payload.
